English: (no direct translation)  Modal Particle  Expresses surprise, emphasis, or strong feeling
That is expensive! (I'm surprised)
also / too / even  Focus Particle  Adds something to an existing reference
I am hungry too.
on earth / just (with concern)  Modal Particle  Expresses worry, curiosity, or emphasis in questions/exclamations
What on earth happened?
(no direct translation)  Modal Particle  Softens a question
column3: makes it sound curious, polite, or interested

English: What's going on? (I wonder / tell me)
(no direct translation)  Modal Particle  Contradicts a negative expectation
Come along! (why not? / I suggest it)
just / simply (with resignation)  Modal Particle  Accepts an unchangeable fact
Then we'll just have to walk (we can't change it).
just / exactly / of all people  Focus Particle  Highlights a specific person or thing as particularly relevant
You of all people should be on time.
(no direct translation)  Modal Particle  Indicates shared knowledge
column3: assumes the listener agrees or already knows

English: That is wonderful! (and you agree with me)
(no direct translation)  Modal Particle  Softens commands or requests
Come here (for a moment / casually).
only / just  Focus Particle  Limits or restricts the statement to one element
I have only one euro.
certainly / indeed / (softens or strengthens)  Modal Particle  Adds confidence, limitation, or mild contradiction
It'll be fine (I'm confident).
even (emphatic)  Focus Particle  Emphasizes an extreme or surprising case

even  Focus Particle  Expresses surprise or unexpected inclusion
